body.name: Capped perturbation and trimming duality handle
body.construction: Use the explicit optimizer \(\delta_l^*=\min\{1,\lambda_\alpha w_l/q_l\}\) to build a block-homogeneous weighted-erasure testing family, prove bounded pairwise divergence from \(\sum_lq_l(\delta_l^*)^2\le x_\alpha\), and dualize its target separation against the subset-trimmed radius \(\rho_\alpha(w,q)\).
